records.purpose: Acquire the exclusive live-owner editor lease for this session.
records.buffer_contract:
`sco_result (*acquire)(sco_plugin* self, uint64_t session, uint64_t* out_lease);`
Acquire the exclusive live-owner editor lease for this session.
records.ownership: Host owns file snapshots; lease and receipts belong to the live caller. Buffers are copied.
records.callback_context: No plugin callbacks. Synchronous host adapter runs outside the service mutex.
records.reentrancy: Operations refuse while a file adapter operation is active.
records.results: OK on success; BAD_ARG for invalid input, WRONG_THREAD, UNAVAILABLE when stopped or busy, NOT_FOUND for stale tokens, TOO_MANY for limits, FAILED for I/O. Outputs untouched on error.
records.absent_capability: Candidate service is unavailable until explicitly composed by the host.
records.cleanup: Owner release revokes the editor and pre-commit work; a post-permit outcome remains host-owned. Stop withdraws the service.
limitations: Unpublished candidate; no native publication or game verification.
